articles.summary: Successful biopharmaceutical organizations begin developing a commercialization strategy in early stages. Instead of waiting until their advanced therapy or biologics product is closer to pivotal trial stages, developers should confront these decisions as soon as possible. In a recent interview with Pharmaceutical Commerce, Gwen Erskine, Senior Director of Consulting Services at Cryoport Systems, illustrates why prioritizing commercialization readiness during early phases of development optimizes profitability, flexibility, and risk management.
articles.title: Prioritizing Commercialization Decisions in Early Stages of Advanced Therapy Development

articles.summary: For cell therapy developers approaching commercialization, manufacturing architecture is a strategic consideration. Decisions made early in the development phases regarding starting material sourcing, process design, storage strategy, and supply chain architecture begin to influence capacity planning, cost structures, operational flexibility, and ultimately patient access.
articles.title: Extended Manufacturability: Why Cryopreservation is a Commercial Enabler

articles.summary: As advanced therapy programs approach commercialization, organizations discover that operational complexity has become their biggest challenge. Despite proven manufacturing processes, clearly defined regulatory pathways, and commercial planning underway, the underlying supply chain remains a collection of systems, vendors, and workflows that evolved over years of clinical development.
articles.title: Commercial Readiness: The ROI of Defragmented Supply Chains

articles.summary: As advanced therapies become more complex and move closer to broader commercial adoption, life sciences organizations are navigating increasingly sophisticated supply chains. From maintaining product integrity across global networks to navigating evolving regulatory requirements, success depends on a supply chain partner capable of delivering consistent, reliable operational execution across the product lifecycle. To continue supporting evolving industry needs, Cryoport Systems is pleased to welcome Chris LaGullo as Chief Operating Officer.
articles.title: Cryoport Systems Welcomes Chris LaGullo as Chief Operations Officer

articles.summary: The animal health industry is evolving rapidly. Biologics, vaccines, reproductive technologies, regenerative medicine applications, and other advanced therapies are reaching important commercial milestones and expanding into broader distribution networks. As organizations move beyond clinical development and pilot programs, they often discover that commercialization requires more than increased production capacity. It demands a supply chain capable of delivering consistency, traceability, and compliance at scale.
articles.title: Commercial Readiness Starts with an Audit-Ready Supply Chain
